learning_outcomes.text: To have detailed information about what addiction is, its types, development and consequences.
Explaining the biological, psychological and social factors leading to addiction.
Understanding the importance of healthy living habits and addiction prevention
Developing solutions to their problems and communicating effectively.
Understanding the importance of legal regulations and policies to combat addiction.
Informing and raising awareness about the harms of addiction.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, Introduction to Course Content, Course Objectives, Definitions of Addiction, Physical and mental addiction
teaching_methods: technology supported teaching methods and techniques
